newsitem.title: ITALY: Assitalia 1996 net profit 67 bill lire.
newsitem.headline: Assitalia 1996 net profit 67 bill lire.

text.p: Italian insurance group Assitalia, controlled by INA, said on Wednesday its 1996 net profit was steady at 67 billion lire from 1995, while pretax profits rose to 117.4 billion lire from 66.7 billion.
The pretax line gained from 111 billion lire of one-off extraordinary income in 1996 compared with nil in 1995. The tax levy for 1996 was 51 billion lire compared with nil in 1995.
Premium income for 1996 amounted to 2.996 trillion lire from 3.023 trillion lire in 1995, the group said in a statement.
The group added that results for the first months of 1997 showed an improved trend from the first quarter of 1996, but was in line with the previous quarter.
The company added that Standard & Poor's ISI rating for Assitalia was raised to "A" during 1996.
